project: CVKI - AI Civic Complaint Intelligence System

experiment_lineage.description: Initial 13-class YOLOv8n detector with core civic categories.
experiment_lineage.outcome: Solid foundational baseline on initial held-out benchmark.

experiment_lineage.description: Exploratory ingestion of expanded noisy dataset annotations.
experiment_lineage.outcome: Degradation observed: precision dropped, false positives on complex background clutter increased. Diagnosed as label noise and domain distribution shift.
experiment_lineage.lesson_learned: Unverified auto-annotations and dataset class imbalance compromise precision. Strict curation protocol required.

experiment_lineage.description: Curation down to 605 high-quality, verified samples across 13 classes with deduplication and bounding box validation.
experiment_lineage.outcome: Recovery of precision and mAP metrics; designated as frozen production baseline with dual held-out test evaluations.

environment.target_hardware: NVIDIA GPU / CUDA 12 compatible (or CPU fallback for edge evaluation)
